answer: A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in ferrous, and umber reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 107 aliases, and each one needs its own funded timber account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 5 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
